qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global #1 staffing scale and digital platform provide operational efficiency, but customer switching barriers are low and enterprise clients routinely multi-source. Pricing power is confined to passing on statutory wage inflation without gross margin spread expansion. ROIC is volatile across the economic cycle, falling to 8.9% in 2024 (10.4% in 2020), failing the standard of durable through-cycle 12%+ capital efficiency.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Moat & Pricing Power, REJECT). World's largest staffing agency boasts excellent operational discipline and a clean balance sheet, but operates in a commoditized, low-barrier industry with near-zero client switching costs and zero real pricing power. Capital returns are cyclical and fell to 8.9% in 2024, failing the durable 12% ROIC proof-of-moat hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: ROIC exhibits extreme cyclicality: FY2020 10.4%, FY2021 16.8%, FY2022 17.9%, FY2023 14.6%, FY2024 8.9%. Gross margins (19-20%) and EBITA margins (3.5-4.5%) lack pricing power above wage inflation. Corporate clients face low switching costs, and the business faces long-term structural headwinds from AI-driven recruitment and white-collar automation.
